properties.name: A limit that a measured reading breaks reads broken, and an open defect finding on it is a line of the loop's next, so a person never sees "nothing open" while the design holds a measurement over its own limit
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-24, option (a) of reflow2:dec:idea-reflow2-becomes-the-web-of-rules-for-a-buildings-ifc-model ("I like a, b, c, and d'")
properties.statement: When a measured reading recorded against a Constraint (from an IFC model, a calculator record or a test) is over or under its limit, the Constraint reads broken, naming the reading and its source. An open defect finding on any node is a line of loop_status's `next` and reaches detect_gaps or detect_defects, until it is closed by a change or a ruling. For a building: after every edit to a model copy, the design's limits (heights, unit areas, unit count, egress, parking ratio) are re-read against the copy's measurements, and each one it keeps or breaks is said. MEASURED 2026-10-23 in SeattleArch, the case this exists for: the roof reads 3 7/16" over the height maximum and all 24 unit areas are off the area table, and none of it reaches open_questions, detect_gaps, detect_defects or loop_status (reflow2:fact:seattlearch-defect-findings-on-its-limits-reach-no-loop-or-gap-report-2026-10-23). This is the 2026-09-28 root cause seen again.
